subject: Private deployment architect session — timing coordination + air-gap checklist
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@finnova.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finnova.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: private deploy architecture deep-dive (VPC + air-gap)

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Our security and infra teams want a focused architecture + operations deep-dive for the planned private deployment. The priorities: VPC networking, air-gapped installation steps, software update cadence, and test restore procedures.

We'd like a 60-90 minute session next week if possible. Our core constraints: east coast availability, one participant based in the UK who prefers a later time slot, and procurement needs a short checklist to start the SOW conversation.

Can you propose two alternative windows next week? Also tell us which Redwood engineers should join — we want someone who can speak to KV cache persistence and the on-prem installer.

Regards,
Sarah Lin
Head of Platform Security, FinNova

Attachments: none
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@finnova.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, procurement@finnova.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: private deploy architecture deep-dive (VPC + air-gap)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear priorities.

We can run a 75-minute session that covers architecture, installer prerequisites, and the air-gap process. Proposed slots (all ET):
- Tue Jun 22, 3:30pm-4:45pm ET
- Wed Jun 23, 11:00am-12:15pm ET

Attendees from Redwood: me (solutions lead), Vivek Kulkarni (inference infra), and Diego Fernandez (deploy ops). If the UK attendee needs after 5pm ET, we can offer Wed 5:15pm-6:30pm ET but that is a bit late for our on-call engineers.

I attached a short pre-kick checklist that procurement can start with and a proposed meeting agenda:
- 10 min: introductions & compliance constraints
- 25 min: VPC networking and routing patterns
- 20 min: air-gapped installer flow and update strategy
- 15 min: runbooks, support model, and Q&A

Please confirm which of the two slots works and whether you want the session remote-only or if you plan to have an on-site observer.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0142

Attachments: finova-prekick-list.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@finnova.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, procurement@finnova.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: private deploy architecture deep-dive (VPC + air-gap)

Looping in a couple of quick asks from the infra side:
- For air-gapped installs we need a simple network diagram from FinNova showing subnet segmentation and the outbound update gateway, if any. I dropped a template you can use: network-diagram-template.vsdx (link below).
- Clarify whether the air-gapped cluster will have physical media transfer windows or an internal artifact mirror. That changes how we demo the installer.
- Please confirm if there will be an on-prem DBA or ops person who can speak to firewall change windows.

If you confirm Tue 3:30pm ET we will prepare a short demo of the offline installer flow.

Thanks,
Vivek
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Links: https://drive.redwood.com/finova/network-diagram-template.vsdx
From: James O'Neill <james.oneill@finnova.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finnova.com, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@finnova.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:15:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: private deploy architecture deep-dive (VPC + air-gap)

Apologies for the time zone churn — our UK compliance lead needs to be on the call. Can we move to Wed 11:00am-12:15pm ET instead? That maps to 4pm BST and is workable.

We will provide the network diagram and confirm whether physical media is needed. Procurement has started on the checklist and will upload a short note on required contracts. We are remote only for this session.

Thanks,
James O'Neill
VP Engineering, FinNova

Thanks James — Wed 11:00am-12:15pm ET works for our team. I've booked the slot and shared a calendar invite: https://cal.com/redwood/architect-deepdive?cid=RNW-9237

Final details for the session:
- When: Wed Jun 23, 11:00am-12:15pm ET (75 minutes)
- Attendees: Sarah Lin, James O'Neill, FinNova compliance lead (TBD), procurement rep, Monica Patel, Vivek Kulkarni, Diego Fernandez
- Prep: FinNova to upload network diagram and confirm whether physical media or internal artifact mirror will be used (attach to the Drive link).
- Attachments we shared: finova-prekick-list.pdf, network-diagram-template.vsdx
- Agenda: same as proposed; Vivek will show the offline installer demo if physical-media flow is required.

Please add any additional attendees and upload pre-reads to the Drive link above by EOD Tue so we can tailor the demo. Looking forward to it.
